text.p: Italian state-controlled engineering group Finmeccanica said it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Britain's General Electric Co Plc (GEC) to study opportunities for collaboration between their respective defence sector companies, Alenia Difesa and GEC Marconi.
Finmeccanica said in a statement the memorandum was signed in London on Tuesday.
Finmeccanica said it and GEC had "a common vision about the evolution of the defence industry at a world level," which was going through a period of major restructuring.
The process of progressive concentration in the sector was particularly advanced in the United States where recent mergers and fusions had given rise to very large industrial groups, it said.
"Finmeccanica and GEC recognise that a further concentration of the European industry is necessary to assure its efficiency and profitability," the statement said.
It said the two companies had common technologies, products and experience. The study of possible collaboration projects will be completed this summer. No further details were given.
